question: Indian music maestro Bhimsen Joshi was related to the ______ Gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirana **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Joshi belongs** to the **Kirana Gharana** tradition of** Hindustani Classical Music.**** **
 
• **Abdul Karim Khan** was an extremely popular musician and was thus highly influential in popularizing the Gharana.
